intro: The gear I actually use. Not a wishlist: what's on my desk, in the workshop, on my shelves and under my wheels.

categories.hint: Consoles and controllers, old and new

items.name: Mac mini M1
items.note: 16GB. The build server: 8 GitHub Actions runners, the agents and everything that has to run without me.

items.name: Desktop PC
items.note: The MSI tower: i5-12400F, RTX 4060, 2TB NVMe. Gaming, editing and heavy lifting.

items.name: Standing desk
items.note: An Autonomous dual-motor frame, 62 to 127 cm, under a 200 × 80 cm solid oak live edge top from Leroy Merlin. The walking pad slides underneath.

items.name: CPOD chair
items.note: The ergonomic chair. Hours of sitting without paying for it the next day.

items.name: Walking pad
items.note: Under the desk: walking through calls.

items.name: Raspberry Pi 3
items.note: In its official red and white case (Amazon, 2017). The first server that fits in a hand.

items.name: Smart bulbs
items.note: Light you adjust without getting up.

items.name: DeskJet 2710
items.note: The printer. Used twice a year, but those two times, it matters.

items.name: iPhone 15 Pro

items.name: Gaming chair
